scope: apps/**/*.py and core/**/*.py excluding migrations; _vN module tokens
policy: Parallel versions must have one declared preferred current version, an exact module inventory, explicit retained-read and write-capable versions, real blockers and retirement gates. A satisfied blocker makes the guard fail until the family is reviewed. Historical append-only rows and hashes must remain readable until archive/restore evidence proves safe retirement.

retirement_gate: Prove the V5/V3 production authority graph with genuine current owner and reviewer decisions.
Inventory production rows and every non-test consumer for V2-V4; old append-only hashes remain readable.
Remove V2-V4 write builders and mutation methods before considering historical codecs or readers.
Pass PostgreSQL archive/restore and exact historical replay before deleting any old table or reader.
Complete genuine V5 owner assignment production acceptance.
Show zero live write callers for V2-V4 and preserve immutable historical receipt replay.
Remove prior-version issue/successor paths before any persistence cleanup.
Verify PostgreSQL backup, restore and hash-equivalent historical reads.
Inventory all production and integration consumers of the V2 read projection.
Prove no current head requires V2 and retain an exact historical export when old evidence rows remain.
Delete V2 only in a separately reviewed compatibility-removal commit.
Complete genuine Authority V3 production issue, successor, revoke and current-head acceptance.
Prove V1/V2 writer builders have no runtime consumer, then remove their write surfaces first.
Keep V1/V2 exact historical readers and codecs until production row inventory, archive/restore and replay pass.
Delete old tables only after every dependent Evidence scope has migrated and rollback evidence is sealed.
Complete genuine Authority V3 production acceptance and inventory every Evidence scope consumer.
Decide whether the V1 source issuer requires a current-version successor before removing its composition path.
Preserve exact V1-V3 historical scope interpretation until archive/restore and hash replay pass.
Remove a prior reader only in a separately reviewed compatibility-removal commit.
Bind a clean deployed candidate and retain a real first monitoring sample.
Complete the full 14-day window, structured defects, 101-task telemetry, backup and two-role attestation.
Require the canonical command to return ALLOW before any A/B Classic cleanup wave.
